subject: Request: MSA publicity carve-out for Acme beta announcement
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: MSA publicity carve-out for Acme beta announcement

Hi Sarah —

Congrats on getting the beta launch scheduled. Acme asked during last week's call if we can allow them to mention Redwood in the public-facing announcement and include a small "Supported by" line with our logo. They attached the draft press copy and the event order form.

Quick ask for legal: can we provide a limited publicity carve-out in the current MSA/order form so they can run the announcement on June 15? The customer is proposing the standard MSA publicity language but wants an exception to the usual 90-day embargo and a specific line allowing logo placement in marketing collateral and their press release.

Relevant attachments: [Attachment: ACME_MSA_redline_v1.docx] [Attachment: OrderForm_Beta_20270524.pdf]

High-level constraints from Acme:
- Announcement date: 2027-06-15
- Short quote from Acme comms (already in draft)
- Use of Redwood logo in a single line: "Supported by Redwood Inference" (no badges or co-branding)
- No sharing of private usage metrics or screenshots of customer data

Ben/Kimberly — can you take a look and propose the least-risky language that gets Acme what they need while preserving our confidentiality obligations? I think we can do a narrow carve-out limited to that one announcement and a single logo usage with a 30-day notice window instead of 90.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ACME_MSA_redline_v1.docx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MSA publicity carve-out for Acme beta announcement

Sounds reasonable — thanks Neha. A couple of clarifying items from my side before legal drafts:

- Is Acme asking for logo asset use on their website and in the press release, or only in the PR byline? Sarah's draft suggests both.
- Do they want attribution language that references specific feature names or metrics? We should avoid any implied endorsement around performance.
- Timeline: they want to lock copy by 2027-06-08.

If legal is okay with a constrained exception, my preference is: narrow, single-event carve-out, logo limited to a monochrome 1-line logo (provided by us), no use in paid ads, and callout that we do not provide endorsement of product performance. Suggest adding a sunset: the announcement can live on their press page for up to 12 months.

Markus — tagging you for any commercial constraints (discount/credit asks) from legal when we sign the exception.

- Ben

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MSA publicity carve-out for Acme beta announcement

Neha / Ben —

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the redline and drafted a narrow publicity carve-out that protects confidentiality while granting Acme the limited rights they requested. Key points in the suggested language (attached):

- Grant limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to reference Redwood and to display a single static Redwood logo in connection with the June 15, 2027 beta announcement.
- Use limited to the press release and their website press page only; explicitly prohibited on paid advertising, product packaging, or third-party endorsements.
- No metrics or screenshots that contain customer data; any product screenshots must be redacted.
- Exception expires 12 months from announcement date unless extended in writing.
- Acme must provide final copy to Redwood for approval at least 5 business days prior to publication (we can do a review for legal-scope-only, not marketing polish).

I attach the proposed clause as plain text for easy insertion: [Attachment: publicity_clause_suggested.txt] and a redline to the MSA: [Attachment: ACME_MSA_redline_v1.docx].

If Ben and Neha sign off, I can send this to the customer as a clean amendment to the MSA (short addendum) and loop procurement for countersignature.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: press@acme.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MSA publicity carve-out for Acme beta announcement

Hi Neha —

Thanks — this works for us. We reviewed Kimberly's suggested language and have two small requests:

1) Can we display a single 24x24 pixel monochrome Redwood logo next to our "Supported by" line on the PR headline and on the event web page?
2) We prefer a 60-day review window instead of 5 business days for compliance routing on our side. If we provide final copy 60 days prior to publication, will Redwood be able to run the legal review and confirm?

We do not plan to include any performance metrics or screenshots. We're happy with the 12-month expiry.

Forwarding Kim's text into our internal PR for visibility and attaching our draft press release: [Forwarded message below] [Attachment: OrderForm_Beta_20270524.pdf]

Appreciate the quick turnaround. If this is acceptable, we'll proceed to sign the addendum once you send the clean version.

Best,
Sarah Li
Head of Communications, Acme Corp
